headline.en: Oaktree closes debut asset-backed finance fund on $2bn
headline.zh: Oaktree 完成首只资产支持融资基金募集，规模 20 亿美元

summary.en: Brookfield-owned Oaktree Capital Management has closed its first asset-backed finance fund on $2bn of commitments. The money was raised across Oaktree's Asset-Backed Finance Fund (ABF I) and related vehicles, with commitments from institutional investors including US public pension schemes and sovereign wealth funds. Oaktree has invested more than $19bn through its wider ABF platform, alongside Brookfield's broader ABF platform of more than $60bn.
summary.zh: Brookfield 旗下 Oaktree Capital Management 已完成其首只资产支持融资基金的募集，募资规模 20 亿美元。资金通过 Oaktree 的 Asset-Backed Finance Fund（ABF I）及相关投资工具募集，出资方为机构投资者，包括美国公共养老金计划和主权财富基金。Oaktree 通过其更广泛的 ABF 平台已投资逾 190 亿美元，该平台与 Brookfield 规模超过 600 亿美元的更广泛 ABF 平台并行。

headline.en: Monroe Capital prices second new-issue CLO of 2026 at $398.9m
headline.zh: Monroe Capital 为 2026 年第二只新发 CLO 定价 3.989 亿美元

summary.en: Monroe Capital priced its second new-issue CLO of 2026, Monroe Capital PC CLO II, at $398.9m. The vehicle holds senior secured loans to lower middle-market and traditional middle-market companies, with investment-grade tranches rated AAA to BBB- and structured to meet US, UK and EU risk-retention rules. Deutsche Bank was lead arranger; Monroe said it has issued $13bn in structured products since founding and manages $23.8bn.
summary.zh: Monroe Capital 为其 2026 年第二只新发 CLO——Monroe Capital PC CLO II——定价 3.989 亿美元。该工具持有面向下中端市场和传统中端市场公司的优先担保贷款，资本结构包含评级从 AAA 到 BBB- 的投资级债务档，并已按美国、英国和欧盟的风险留存要求进行结构化设计。德意志银行担任主安排行；Monroe 表示自成立以来已发行 130 亿美元结构化产品，管理资产规模达 238 亿美元。

headline.en: SEC proposes rules to widen retail access to private credit
headline.zh: SEC 提议放宽散户投资私募信贷的渠道

summary.en: The SEC voted this week to propose rule amendments to widen retail investors' access to alternative assets, including private credit. The proposals include modernising the interval fund framework so vehicles can schedule repurchases to better match portfolio liquidity, and amending fund registration and reporting forms to require disclosure of performance-based compensation. The SEC is also seeking comment on new routes to accredited investor status not based on wealth.
summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）本周投票提出一系列规则修订，以扩大散户投资者对包括私募信贷在内的另类资产的准入。提议包括“现代化”区间基金框架，使基金可按更契合其投资组合流动性状况的时间安排回购，并修订基金注册和报告表格，要求披露基于业绩的报酬。SEC 还在就无需依赖财富门槛的合格投资者新认定途径征求意见。

items.source_headline: SEC opens door further to retail private credit push
